name: PointCast Pets
description: PointCast Pets is the plan for local-first site companions: the current site pet, its live name poll and care loop, Zen Cats, future room pets, passport care receipts, and Tezos-ready collectible paths.

surfaces.title: PointCast Pet
surfaces.role: The existing browser-local creature tied to votes, drops, quiet rooms, and games.

surfaces.title: PointCast Pets Plan
surfaces.role: The public planning board and machine-readable manifest for the pet system.

surfaces.title: Site Pet Name Poll
surfaces.role: The Phase 1 public vote on the site pet name: Beacon, Pixel, Nimbus, Scout, or Dot.

surfaces.title: Zen Cat Garden
surfaces.role: Daily calm cat collection, local care ritual, and PCCAT mint path.

roster.name: The Site Pet
roster.careLoop: Feed with votes, water with daily drops, rest in quiet rooms, spark with games.
roster.nextMove: Name poll is open; richer mood labels, local care history, and the home chip are Phase 1.
roster.mintPath: none yet; keep it browser-local until the care loop has personality.

roster.name: Zen Cats
roster.careLoop: Daily care ritual, local collection, Genesis shelf, and World Atelier stamps.
roster.nextMove: Originate dedicated PCCAT FA2, then turn completed ritual days into mintable receipts.
roster.mintPath: PCCAT FA2 planned; Visit Nouns stays Noun-specific.

roster.name: Harbor Pup
roster.careLoop: Tide checks, harbor cards, morning visits, and route completions.
roster.nextMove: Prototype after Morning Ocean shelf state is stable.
roster.mintPath: Consider only after Morning Ocean collectible metadata ships.

roster.name: Garden Companion
roster.careLoop: Plant choices, houseplant diagnoses, outdoor field notes, and harvest receipts.
roster.nextMove: Define a plant-care crossover without duplicating /houseplants.
roster.mintPath: No contract before the loop proves it creates repeat visits.

phases.label: Now
phases.title: Make the system legible
phases.summary: Publish /pets, /pets.json, a plan doc, and a Block receipt so pets become a named PointCast surface.

phases.label: Live build
phases.title: Upgrade the existing site pet
phases.summary: Add the name poll, personality states, better care history, and a small home chip that does not crowd the feed.

phases.label: Pilot
phases.title: Tie pets to rooms
phases.summary: Let different rooms raise different companions while sharing passport stamps and local state conventions.

phases.label: Mint Path
phases.title: Collect only after behavior is proven
phases.summary: Keep care local first. Only mint pets whose rituals have repeat value, clear metadata, and a dedicated contract lane.

decisions.question: Should the existing site pet get a fixed name, a poll-selected name, or visitor-local nicknames?
decisions.recommendation: Use /poll/site-pet-name; do not treat the winner as canonical until Mike accepts the result.

decisions.question: Which pets deserve dedicated contracts versus local-only receipts?
decisions.recommendation: Zen Cats first because the metadata path already exists; keep Site Pet local until the loop is loved.

decisions.question: How visible should pets be on the front door?
decisions.recommendation: Use one compact status chip near the Play Layer, not another large homepage module.

decisions.question: What pet state can agents safely describe?
decisions.recommendation: Agents may describe public rules and storage keys, but must not infer a visitor owns or cared for a pet without supplied state.

moodLadder.label: sleepy signal
moodLadder.summary: The default local state before the visitor has fed much signal into the loop.

moodLadder.label: waking signal
moodLadder.summary: A little care is present: one or two actions, stamps, or visits are visible locally.

moodLadder.label: bright signal
moodLadder.summary: The pet has enough recent local care to read as active.

moodLadder.label: beacon signal
moodLadder.summary: The local care loop is highly charged across the main participation stats.

namePoll.question: What should the PointCast site pet be called?

options.label: Beacon
options.hint: A small public signal that gets brighter when people participate.

options.label: Pixel
options.hint: Tiny, visual, and native to the site screen.

options.label: Nimbus
options.hint: Soft room-weather energy for a companion that follows the whole site.

options.label: Scout
options.hint: A friendly guide through votes, drops, quiet rooms, and games.

options.label: Dot
options.hint: Minimal, readable, and small enough for the front door.

namePoll.outcome: The leading name can become the public pet label after review; local care history stays private.

storagePolicy.publicAgentRule: Agents may cite rules, routes, and storage keys. Agents must not infer a visitor has a pet, stamp, or care history unless the visitor supplies local state.

agentProtocol.planStatus: Use phases and queue as the source of truth for what exists, what is queued, and what is gated.
agentProtocol.localState: Pet state is browser-local. Do not claim a visitor has completed care actions unless that visitor supplies localStorage-derived state.
agentProtocol.namePoll: The site pet name poll is public at /poll/site-pet-name, but the result is not a canonical pet name until reviewed and accepted.
agentProtocol.mintLanguage: Describe pets as local-first unless a roster item has a live dedicated contract. Zen Cats are Tezos-ready, not mint-live until PCCAT has a KT1 address.
